crossRefs.note: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.
But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I…
Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will…

translations.web: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by man’s judgment. Yes, I don’t judge my own self.
translations.bsb: I care very little, however, if I am judged by you or by any human court. In fact, I do not even judge myself.
translations.kjv: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.
translations.asv: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.
